title: Chapter 148 Victory News
content:
Chapter 148 Victory News

Meanwhile, at the unknown boundary.

At this moment, the huge wormhole finally slowly closed.

However, everyone's expressions were not at all joy.

Because this means that the Spirit-Devouring Army has gathered and the war is about to begin!

In the distance, Shi Chen looked deeply at the direction of the empire, and then said with a ferocious look: "My sons, kill!"

"Totally swallow this star field!!"

As the sound fell, the entire Spirit-Devouring Army suddenly roared.

The terrifying aura swept towards everyone like a storm.

At this moment, the entire unknown boundary completely evolved into a forbidden area.

Countless terrifying auras continued to interweave, and the void was trembling wildly.

Seeing the Spirit-Devouring Army approaching the border, the divine generals of the Divine Dynasty and the Huangcheng immediately roared: "Kill the alien race!"

"kill!"

boom!

In an instant, the terrifying fighting spirit suddenly soared into the sky, shattering the sky.

The leader Yun Qi rushed to the forefront with a shocking fighting spirit. The God of War was in power, showing what it means to be a man who was at the gate of thousands of men.

Looking at Yun Qi's bravery, the rest of the people were suddenly filled with passion.

"Go together!"

Gu Chen and his men immediately shouted.

With the top combat powers from Huangcheng joining the battlefield, the entire Spirit-Devouring Clan was really blocked for a moment.

The terrifying pressure of the Spirit-Devouring Clan has been torn apart by the Lu family army led by Yun Qi.

However, this is only temporary after all.

The Spirit-Devouring Clan is naturally really capable of swallowing so many star fields.

Even though Shi Chen had not taken action yet, the Spirit Devouring Clan still had a large number of super-divine powerhouses at the forefront. In just a moment, it took advantage of its numerical advantage to block the attack of Yun Qi and others.

When everyone noticed the situation on the battlefield, they immediately looked solemn.

If this continues, the Spirit-Devouring Clan will not be able to stop it.

At this moment, the Rock God General suddenly shouted: "Everyone, please hold on for a while!"

Accompanied by its super-divine aura, it soon spread throughout the battlefield.

When everyone heard this, they also began to exert their strength.

The sword intent in Huang Shou's body suddenly began to become manic, and it was visible to the naked eye that Huang Shou's sword intent gradually developed from a light yellow to a blood-red direction.

As Huang Shou's sword in his hand increased, there was finally a bang.

Huang Shou's sword intent was completely transformed.

Killing sword intent!

At this moment, the terrifying killing aura continued to surge out of Huang Shou's body.

"The sword opens the galaxy!"

laugh!

I saw a terrifying sword light suddenly appeared from the center of the battlefield, and then continued to advance towards the Spirit-Devouring Clan. Nowhere was passed, I lived.

This sword broke open a bloody path.

Seeing this scene, everyone's morale suddenly increased!

"Brother Huang is good at swordsmanship!"

Listening to the continuous praise of the people around him, Huang Shou had no joy on his face, but instead looked at the other side of the battlefield with a serious expression.

At this moment, Huang Shou's face changed drastically, and he immediately retreated wildly.

boom!

The next moment, the place where Huang Shou was just now turned into nothingness.

Seeing this, Huang Shou looked solemn, but before he could react, a black shadow appeared in front of him in an instant.

"Die!"

Bang!

A muffled sound rang out.

Huang Shou suddenly retreated repeatedly, looking at the cracks on the sword in his hand, Huang Shou slowly looked up.

I saw a spirit-eating race at the peak of the super god realm looking at him with a sarcastic look.

"Is the sword intent awesome, is it amazing?"

"To be honest, let alone the Sword God, even the God of War I, the Spirit-Devouring Clan, have killed me."

Hearing such arrogant words, Huang Shou slowly stepped forward.

Buzz —

The endless sword intent suddenly condensed from the surrounding void.

"You shouldn't have shown up."

Huang Shou said coldly.

Hearing this, the powerful Spirit-Devouring Clan in front of him suddenly shrank, and at this time, a figure came from his ears.

"Get out quickly!"

Looking at Huang Piaoshi again, a hint of fear appeared in his eyes.

"Don't find opportunities by me!"

Then, his figure disappeared from the spot again.

Seeing this scene, Huang Shou shook his head slightly, "It's too late to leave now."

With the sound of a shocking sword sounded.

A bloody figure suddenly appeared not far in front of Huang Shou.

It was the powerful spirit-eating tribe just now.

"Sword, Sword Domain! You!"

The fear in his eyes had almost turned into reality. When he was in the sword domain, his figure had nowhere to hide.

The advantage of being proud of disappeared.

At this time, several super god-level spirit-eating tribe powerful people on the battlefield were quickly coming here.

Obviously, these spirit-eating races are not brainless creatures, they also understand strategies.

"Brother Huang, just take action, let's help you block it!"

The shouts of Awei and others came to his ears, and an invisible smile suddenly appeared on Huang Shou's face.

He looked at the powerful spirit-eating tribe in front of him again, and his eyes were instantly filled with murderous intent.

At this moment, he was very glad that the first choice of this guy was himself. If it were someone else, he still didn't know how miserable his own people died.

"Change."

Huang Shou spoke slowly.

Suddenly, countless terrifying sword intents condensed from around him towards his hands.

At the same time, an invisible domain slowly appeared in its true form.

This is his sword domain.

Although he had already realized it, he had basically never used it on weekdays.

With his sword path in mind, his sword domain has also been developed by him.

If he hadn't met the strong man in front of him, he would have been a little confused about the sword domain.

"go."

As the sound fell, the terrifying blow that condensed the ultimate sword intent suddenly rushed towards the powerful spirit-eating tribe with an indescribable speed.

Wherever you pass, a very hideous space scratch emerged from the void.

That is a sign of too strong power.

"The patriarch avenges me!"

"ah!!"

As a scream rang out, the powerful Spirit-Devouring Clan died.

This is the first super-divine realm-level strongman in the game, and it is also an existence above the super-divine realm.

This move undoubtedly gave the Shen Dynasty and everyone in the Huangcheng area a great confidence.

At the same time, Yun Qi also led the Lu family army to completely tear open a huge gap in the Spirit-Devouring Army.

If it weren't for the fact that the number of troops led by Yun Qi was too different from the Soul-Devouring Army, everyone would even think that Yun Qi could defeat the entire Soul-Devouring Army alone.

In the distance, Shi Chen, who stood in the void, looked a little ugly.

The creatures here were so tenacious, which he didn't expect.

This is the first time their Spirit-Devouring Clan has entered.

Long ago, this was their next target of the Spirit-Devouring Clan.

It’s a pity that when I was about to take action, I met a madman.

It was Yan Lingyun that caused their Spirit-Devouring Clan to recuperate for endless years, and it was not until now that they started the road to devouring again.

So for Yan Lingyun, not only him, but also the entire Spirit-Devouring Clan hated him extremely!
